name: yui_aux_0003
statement: ∀ (e C : ℝ), 0 < C → e ≤ KdVPlan.ag gamma → (∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH gamma f → KdVPlan.MemH e g → KdVPlan.MemH 0 (KdVPlan.mul f g) ∧ KdVPlan.srcN 0 (KdVPlan.mul f g) ≤ C * KdVPlan.srcN gamma f * KdVPlan.srcN e g) → ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ f g, KdVPlan.MemH gamma f → KdVPlan.MemH (KdVPlan.ag gamma) g → KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.mul f g) (D * KdVPlan.hn gamma f * KdVPlan.hn (KdVPlan.ag gamma) g)
proof:
intro e C hC he hprod
have hc := @yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_H002 h_E005 h_T013
refine ⟨C * KdVPlan.csrc, mul_pos hC hc, ?_⟩
intro f g hf hg
have hinc := @yui_aux_0002 T gamma R h_H002 h_E005 h_T013 e (KdVPlan.ag gamma) g he hg
obtain ⟨hm, hs⟩ := hprod f g hf hinc.1
refine ⟨hm, ?_⟩
unfold KdVPlan.srcN at hs
have hs' : KdVPlan.csrc * KdVPlan.hn 0 (KdVPlan.mul f g) ≤ KdVPlan.csrc * ((C * KdVPlan.csrc) * KdVPlan.hn gamma f * KdVPlan.hn e g) := by
  convert hs using 1 <;> ring
have hb := le_of_mul_le_mul_left hs' hc
exact hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinc.2 (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (mul_pos hC hc)) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)))
